visualCharacteristics.purpose: before/after case results shown as a scrolling card carousel
visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: two stacked photos per card with BEFORE / AFTER tags
visualCharacteristics.layout: horizontal scroll-snap track (4 across on desktop) with previous/next controls when it overflows

contentPattern.structure: before image | after image | text (H3 condition title, duration paragraph); the two images may share one cell (first = before, second = after)

suitableFor: case-result cards pairing two images with a short caption
